text: {"frames":["The mill on the third floor turns by itself, though no wind stirs the leaves outside. Gareth the mapmaker climbs up with his ink pot and finds a slip of paper pinned to the wheel. It says the mill has ground {a} sacks of flour, but the baker below swears he has counted only {b}. Gareth wants the mill to tell the truth before the wheel turns the whole Tower round. Which sign goes between {a} and {b}?","Every night Marijke seals her fog in jars and lines them up in the cellar, and every morning the cellar hums. Her grandmother's list says the cellar should hold {a} jars, but when you count, you find {b}. Something down there is keeping the fog for itself, and the jars are sweating. Which sign goes between {a} and {b}, to show whether the fog is short or spare?","All the windows of the crooked house under the hoist beam glow gold, though nobody lives there. Mr Tielman the lamplighter wrote in his book that he lit {a} lamps last night. This morning the lamps still burning in the windows number {b}, and the book's edges are damp. Which sign goes between {a} and {b}?","At midnight a bell rings under the Tower, though Fenna tied its rope shut before dark. On the wall of the stair a new shadow waits, and it is not hers. Fenna chalked the shadows last night and found {a} of them, and now she counts {b}. Which sign goes between {a} and {b}, so she knows whether the shadows are multiplying?","A wet stork lands on the bridge over the Tower canal and taps his beak on a old map. He says the canal drawn there has {a} locks, but the map of the water board shows only {b}. Joop cannot fly to the next lock until someone sorts out the number. Which sign goes between {a} and {b}?"]}
